**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

Section 22 (Audit Rights) is the sole audit/verification right binding us — §23 has no operative text and no other inspection, records, or remote-monitoring right exists in the document. It already meets every preferred element:

- Frequency: "no more than once in any twelve-month period"
- Notice: "at least thirty days' prior written notice"
- Business hours: "during normal business hours"
- Independent auditor + confidentiality: "an independent auditor bound by confidentiality"
- Off-site: "conducted off-site where practicable"
- Cost: Vendor bears costs unless underpayment exceeds five percent (§22.2)
- No system access: "Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems directly" (§22.2)

No redline proposed.
